tasks.title: Exam-style tasks - 1
tasks.context: Evaluate each statement. Mark it TRUE or FALSE.
statements: An observatory sold 140 admissions, charging \$18 for adults and \$10 for children, and collected \$2{,}048. If the two admission counts are unknown, the receipt implies $85$ adult admissions.
A greenhouse combines an unknown mass of $8\%$ nitrogen soil with an unknown mass of $20\%$ soil. The $60$ kg blend tests at $13\%$, and the manager claims $25$ kg came from the $20\%$ stock.
A violin teacher and a student have a combined age of $66$ years, and the teacher is $24$ years older. Solving the two present ages makes the teacher $48$ years old.
A survey drone flies with a tailwind at $78$ km/h and into the same wind at $54$ km/h. Treating still-air speed and wind speed as unknowns, its still-air speed is $66$ km/h.
A bakery makes muffin trays and tart trays. One plan has $x+y=46$ trays and uses $2x+5y=158$ kilograms of mix. These two resource limits give $28$ muffin trays.
tactical_explanations:
**A.** → False

Write both stem conditions as linear equations in the two unknowns, then solve the system for the quantity named in the claim.

$$1x+1y=140$$

$$18x+10y=2048$$

$$\Delta=1(10)-1(18)=-8$$

$$x=\frac{140(10)-1(2048)}{-8}=81$$

$$y=\frac{1(2048)-140(18)}{-8}=59$$

The system gives $81$ for adult admissions, not $85$.

So the statement is False.

**B.** → True

Label the unknowns from the stem, form the coefficient matrix, and read off the claimed component of the solution.

$$1x+1y=60$$

$$20x+8y=780$$

$$\Delta=1(8)-1(20)=-12$$

$$x=\frac{60(8)-1(780)}{-12}=25$$

$$y=\frac{1(780)-60(20)}{-12}=35$$

The system gives $25$ kg for kilograms of high-nitrogen soil, exactly as claimed.

So the statement is True.

**C.** → False

Clear the story into a $2\times 2$ model first; only then test the numerical claim against the recovered values.

$$1x+1y=66$$

$$1x-1y=24$$

$$\Delta=1(-1)-1(1)=-2$$

$$x=\frac{66(-1)-1(24)}{-2}=45$$

$$y=\frac{1(24)-66(1)}{-2}=21$$

The system gives $45$ years for teacher's age, not $48$ years.

So the statement is False.

**D.** → True

Translate each reported total into an equation, eliminate one variable, and compare the remaining unknown with the claim.

Build the $2	imes 2$ system from the stem, then solve for the claimed unknown.

$$1x+1y=78$$

$$1x-1y=54$$

$$\Delta=1(-1)-1(1)=-2$$

$$x=\frac{78(-1)-1(54)}{-2}=66$$

$$y=\frac{1(54)-78(1)}{-2}=12$$

The system gives $66$ km/h for still-air drone speed, exactly as claimed.

So the statement is True.

**E.** → False

Set up the mix from the stem as a linear system and check whether the claimed figure matches the solved value.

$$1x+1y=46$$

$$2x+5y=158$$

$$\Delta=1(5)-1(2)=3$$

$$x=\frac{46(5)-1(158)}{3}=24$$

$$y=\frac{1(158)-46(2)}{3}=22$$

The system gives $24$ for muffin trays, not $28$.

So the statement is False.

statements: A cooling system needs $50$ liters made only from $30\%$ and $70\%$ antifreeze. To finish at $46\%$, the mechanic must pour $20$ liters of the stronger fluid.

$$1x-1y=18$$

$$\Delta=1(-1)-1(1)=-2$$

$$x=\frac{92(-1)-1(18)}{-2}=55$$

$$1x+4y=88$$

$$\Delta=3(4)-2(1)=10$$

$$x=\frac{94(4)-2(88)}{10}=20$$

$$y=\frac{3(88)-94(1)}{10}=17$$

statements: A grandmother is now four times her granddaughter's age. In $12$ years she will be twice as old as the granddaughter then. The grandmother is currently $30$ years.

$$1x-4y=0$$

$$1x-2y=12$$

$$\Delta=1(-2)--4(1)=2$$

$$x=\frac{0(-2)--4(12)}{2}=24$$

$$y=\frac{1(12)-0(1)}{2}=6$$

$$1x-1y=14$$

$$\Delta=3(-1)-3(1)=-6$$

$$x=\frac{330(-1)-3(14)}{-6}=62$$

$$y=\frac{3(14)-330(1)}{-6}=48$$

So the statement is True.

Compare both coefficients and constants to determine how many intersections the two constraints have.

$$2x+6y=48$$

$$1x+3y=24$$

$$\Delta=2(3)-6(1)=0$$

$$(1,3,24)=0.5(2,6,48)$$

$$L_2=L_1$$

So the statement is False.

**D.** → True

Build the $2	imes 2$ system from the stem, then solve for the claimed unknown.

$$1x+1y=85$$

$$24x+14y=1770$$

$$\Delta=1(14)-1(24)=-10$$

$$x=\frac{85(14)-1(1770)}{-10}=58$$

$$y=\frac{1(1770)-85(24)}{-10}=27$$

The system gives $58$ for car fares, exactly as claimed.

So the statement is True.

**E.** → False

Set up the mix from the stem as a linear system and check whether the claimed figure matches the solved value.

$$1x+1y=40$$

$$21x+12y=624$$

$$\Delta=1(12)-1(21)=-9$$

$$x=\frac{40(12)-1(624)}{-9}=16$$

$$y=\frac{1(624)-40(21)}{-9}=24$$

$$\Delta=1(-1)-1(1)=-2$$

$$x=\frac{46(-1)-1(8)}{-2}=27$$

Two production records are

$$2x + 5y = 40 \tag{1}$$

$$2 \cdot 15 - 5 \cdot 6 = 0$$

$$x = 20 - \tfrac{5}{2}y$$

tasks.solution_overview:
A $50$ kg tea blend mixes premium tea at \$30/kg with standard tea at \$18/kg so the total cost is \$1{,}140.

Let $x$ = kg of premium and $y$ = kg of standard.

$$x + y = 50 \tag{1}$$

$$30x + 18y = 1140 \tag{2}$$

Multiply (1) by $18$ and subtract from (2):

$$12x = 240$$

$$x = 20,\qquad y = 30$$

Premium cost is $30 \times 20 = 600$.

tasks.solution_overview:
A boat travels downstream at $25$ knots and upstream at $17$ knots against the same tide.

Three upstream hours cover $3(x-y) = 3 \times 17 = 51$ nautical miles.

$$(4x + 3y) - (4x + 10y) = 123 - 242$$
